<timestamp>Friday, Jul 24, 2026, 9:55 AM (UTC+2)</timestamp>

can you find where the css tailwind ratio for charts is
I'll search the chart code for Tailwind aspect-ratio classes.

The chart aspect ratio is **`aspect-3/2`** (3:2). Main places:

- `apps/frontend/src/components/tool-calls/display-chart.tsx` — primary chart container (lines ~167 and ~250)
- `apps/frontend/src/components/mcp-app/chart-app-view.tsx` — MCP chart view
- `apps/frontend/src/components/tool-calls/mcp.tsx` — MCP tool chart wrapper
- `apps/frontend/src/components/tool-calls/display-map.tsx` / `display-map-view.tsx` — maps use the same ratio

There's also `aspect-video` (16:9) in the Shadcn `apps/frontend/src/components/ui/chart.tsx` wrapper, and `aspect-auto` when charts are in "normal size" / expanded mode.

`chart-builder.tsx` doesn't set the Tailwind aspect ratio — only the outer display wrappers do.
